title: When is a large language model a good calibration agent? Physics-labeled prompting for budgeted engineering simulator calibration
abstract: arXiv:2610.22379v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Calibrating expensive engineering simulators requires tuning model parameters to match reference data, a process heavily constrained by computational costs. This study investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs), conditioned on physical diagnostic descriptions of simulation errors, can propose informative parameter updates more efficiently than conventional derivative-free optimizers. We test this on a cylinder-wake Large-Eddy Simulation and a damped-oscillator inverse problem. Physics-labeled prompts are evaluated against four text ablations (removed, anonymized, padded, misdirected) and standard optimizers (Nelder-Mead, Bayesian optimization, CMA-ES, and random search). Results demonstrate a strong early semantic advantage: the first physics-informed LLM proposal improves the initial design in 23 of 25 trials. translated_title: 什么时候大语言模型是一个好的校准智能体？面向预算受限工程模拟器校准的物理标注提示方法
translated_abstract: 校准昂贵的工程模拟器需要调整模型参数以匹配参考数据，这一过程受到计算成本的严重制约。本研究探讨大语言模型（LLM）在以模拟误差的物理诊断描述为条件时，能否比传统无导数优化器更高效地提出有价值的参数更新建议。研究在圆柱尾流大涡模拟和阻尼振荡器逆问题上进行了测试，将物理标注提示与四种文本消融对照（移除、匿名化、填充、误导）以及标准优化器（Nelder-Mead、贝叶斯优化、CMA-ES和随机搜索）进行了对比评估。结果表明存在显著的早期语义优势：在25次试验中有23次，首个基于物理信息的LLM提议改善了初始设计；经过五次评估后，中位校准误差比无物理信息的对照组低21.9倍。然而，这一优势……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现在计算预算受限的工程模拟器校准任务中，以物理诊断描述为条件的提示能让大语言模型在早期评估阶段显著优于传统无导数优化器——首个物理信息提议在25次试验中23次改善初始设计，五次评估后中位校准误差降低21.9倍。
en_tdlr: Physics-labeled prompting enables LLMs to substantially outperform conventional derivative-free optimizers in the early stages of budgeted engineering simulator calibration, with the first physics-informed proposal improving initial designs in 23 of 25 trials and reducing median calibration error by 21.9 times after five evaluations.
